name: A capability lives in the engineering section named for it, and applications only compose
asks: "X should go in X-engineering-services-section. It really is that simple." (2026-09-11) "qwzspace, and all applications, are meant to *compose* scripts from services sections." "You should NEVER cannibalize a decommissioned package by moving its capabilities into *another app*." The full statements are in the cited utterances; the 2026-10-10 specification of where capabilities live states the placement and the open points.

x-provenance.recorded-by: games-engines pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: Every capability is held by its owning engineering services section, and applications and games compose from those sections.

requirements.says: Each capability shall be owned by the engineering services section named for it, so that X lives in X-engineering-services-section.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 14:00 (13:15 UTC message): "X should go in X-engineering-services-section. It really is that simple."

requirements.says: Each application, QwzSpace among them, shall compose scripts from the services sections that own the capabilities it uses and shall carry none of them.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "qwzspace, and all applications, are meant to *compose* scripts from services sections."

requirements.says: The dissolution of a decommissioned package shall move each of its capabilities into the services section that owns it and into no other application.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "You should NEVER cannibalize a decommissioned package by moving its capabilities into *another app*"; QwzSpace is itself to be dissolved the same way, so moving work into it defers the work.

requirements.says: The FAE package shall be dissolved into the services sections that own its components; FAE was never meant to exist as a package.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11: "FAE was never meant to exist as a package and we're literally spending hundreds of dollars to just dissolve its components into the actual services section."

requirements.says: The QwzSpace application shall sit at graphical-web-server-services-section/apps/qwzspace, with graphical-web-server under web-server and web-server under web-engine.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 14:03: "qwzspace is meant to be an app under like, graphical-web-server-services-section/apps/qwzspace, graphical-web-server being under web-server, being under web-engine."

requirements.says: A capability relocated to its owner shall leave no wrapper, shim or re-export in its former place.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 15:00: making feltos's capability "a thin wrapper rather than eliminating feltos's ownership of that capability entirely ... is STILL WRONG."

requirements.says: The Group's code shall hold exactly one form of each data class and function, reconciling divergent copies into one system.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 15:07: "there are multiple divergent forms of the same data class and functions and you are simply refusing to reconcile them into one system"; multiple packages already do what single-command-game-protocol-service does and should be used.

requirements.says: The interface engine Abrash shall live at computer-interface-system-services-section/services/graphical-computer-interface-system-services-sections/apps/abrash.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-08-26: "abrash is clearly an interface engine, so should go to ... graphical-computer-interface-system-services-sections/apps/abrash/"; the relocation was done.

requirements.says: The harness lifecycle journal shall live in the agent harness section as src/harness-lifecycle.mjs or an equivalent file where Claude Code and Codex harnesses share it.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-22: harness-lifecycle-journal-service "if it's something that the claude code and codex harness share, then it should probably be in agent-harness-computer-system-engineering-services-section/src/harness-lifecycle.mjs or similar".

requirements.says: The LAGOON package shall be written in GNU Guile, and the files filed under it that are not Guile shall be refiled at the sections that own them.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-22: "LAGOON is meant to be *GUILE* so literally everything here is definitionally misfiled".

requirements.says: Wrong, drifted and duplicate information found in the house shall be removed when it is found, and its removal shall not wait on further investigation.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 20:09 and 14:03: "Start removing duplicate/drifted/wrong information NOW. YOU NEED TO STOP HEARING ME CORRECT YOU AND THEN LEAVING THE WRONG INFORMATION ON DISC"; "you're not being nearly aggressive enough in actually fixing stuff deep upstream and actually removing duplicates".

requirements.says: The Group's development pipeline shall carry rough text (chats, journals, notes) through described terms and successive specifications to spec-driven code generation and codemods.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-27: "we have code and knowledge for going from questions to code, like, praxis programming paradigm ... and even code for working up arc42, and the idea is to go from rough text ... through pipelines of specification ending in spec-driven-development codegen/codemod."

requirements.says: The Group's games and engines shall be revised so that they use the Sign family and the Group's upstream software, and the revision shall be made in the underlying software and not only in the leaves.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-27: "*most* of our games are not written to use SignStuff, or our other upstream software, very well ... we don't just want to improve the leaves: we want to make the underlying software a better realization of the theory".
